annotations.title: Set up SAML SSO for a team

description: SAML SSO for a team (Team add-on, owners only; the company domain must be set first with set_team_domain). Pass the identity provider's SAML metadata URL; returns the ACS URL and Entity ID to paste into the IdP, plus a sign-in link for members. off=true removes it. get_team_settings reads the current setup.
name: set_team_sso
title: Set up SAML SSO for a team
